description: This file defines the DisplaysService class, which manages the visibility of devices in an Angular application, utilizing RxJS for reactive data streams and dependency injection to interact with DeviceService.

classes.name: DisplaysService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing device display visibility and emitting display change events.

methods.name: toggleVisibility
methods.description: Toggle the visibility state of a device by its ID.

methods.name: isVisibleDevice
methods.description: Check if a device with the given ID is currently visible.

methods.name: getDeviceVisibilities
methods.description: Return an observable of device visibility information.

methods.name: getDisplayInfoChanged
methods.description: Return an observable that emits when display info changes.

methods.name: onDeviceDisplayInfo
methods.description: Handle incoming device display data and emit change events.

methods.name: addToVisibleDevices
methods.description: Add a device ID to the list of visible devices.

methods.name: removeFromVisibleDevices
methods.description: Remove a device ID from the list of visible devices.
